name: Fenrir
subtitle: Fen-Dweller
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The great Fenris Wolf was long imprisoned by Asgard’s gods, for he was prophesied to consume the sun and slay Odin come Ragnarok. Now the Shattering has broken his bonds, freeing him to hunt, but he has not grown to nearly the power that was foretold. Resentment and hatred drive his predations—but so, too, does the voice of Chaos itself.
divinity_generator: Gain [60] Divinity when inflicting damage to enemies under [Bleed].

skills.name: Omen of Ragnarok
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, place 2 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on the target which cannot be resisted if this hero has 100% C.RATE. Also place [mechanic:barrier] on this hero equal to 5% of the damage inflicted. If the target is under 10 Stacks of [mechanic:bleed], increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increases the damage of this hero’s Ultimate Ability by 5% (stacking up to 100%), each time it is used.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. 2%HP this hero for each stack of [mechanic:bleed] on the target. If the target is under 5 or more [mechanic:bleed] stacks, this attack cannot Weak Hit.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the target is under 10 Stacks of [Bleed], each hit also increase this hero’s CDMG by 5% (stacking up to 10 times).

skills.name: Blood-fuelled
skills.description: Enemies under [mechanic:bleed] have their Turn Meter reduction effects reduced by 100%.

skills.name: Untamed Fury
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 75% to activate 3 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on the target. If the target is under 10 Stacks of [mechanic:bleed], gain an [Extra Turn].
skills.awakening_bonus: Activates all stacks of [Bleed] on the target instead.
